texts.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的居民持续地在他们的公共生活空间中创造出原始的、艺术化的代表作品，我们注意到其中有些图像开始显露出我们的轮廓。

现在看来，我们在这颗星球上的所作所为很可能已经引起了注意。
texts.en:
As the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] continue to create crude, artistic representations in their communal living spaces, we have noticed some images have begun to look like us.

It now seems likely that our efforts on the planet have attracted notice.

label.zh: 他们描绘了我们的样子。不可思议！
label.en: They have captured our likeness. Fascinating!

label.zh: 这画的什么东西。给我抹了！
label.en: Their scribbles insult us. Remove them!

label.zh: 我们已经污染了他们的文化。以后得多加小心。
label.en: We have contaminated their culture. Take more care in future.
